claim_boundary: This plan changes proposal routing only. The frozen official evaluator, held-out protocol, and promotion gates remain authoritative.

environment_records.mechanism_hypothesis: Uniform sliding-window sampling underexposes sparse pusher-rope contact transitions. Reweighting the upper quantile of action-transition and visual-motion windows should improve contact response without changing the frozen evaluation protocol.
environment_records.falsification_test: Reject when the 512-step held-out horizon AUC does not improve, or when the official 50-step gate fails any PSNR, SSIM, MSE, or masked-MSE condition.
